title: Jalapeño Crispy Briny Argentinian Toast
description: A savory and crunchy toasted bread recipe with a hint of brininess from the capers, served with a side of creamy vanilla sauce.
instructions: Preheat a copper pot or skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the pot and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
Add the chopped jalapeño and cook for 1 minute, until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the toasted bread slices to the pot and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy.
Remove the bread from the pot and sprinkle with capers, salt, and black pepper.
Serve the toasted bread with a dollop of yogurt and a drizzle of vanilla extract.
Refrigerate the remaining yogurt and vanilla extract mixture in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
Reheat the toasted bread and yogurt sauce in the copper pot for 30 seconds, until warmed through.
